context: A boss briefs an intern on an international meeting
purpose: Teach: 岡崎/星野/ウィリアム/デイヴィッド/ゲイツ/蘭/是非とも/アタック

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外プロジェクト、岡崎工場の視察から始める。
lines.en: Ren, start the international project with a tour of the Okazaki plant.
lines.style: Clear, steady directive. Measured pace. No performance — the tone of someone assigning work they trust will be done. Light emphasis on the opening name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。星野部長、現場で待っているそうですね。
lines.en: Yes. Director Hoshino is waiting for us at the site.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Slight lift at the start — meeting the instruction with readiness, not servility. Steady breath. Alert presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 夜は、ウィリアム氏、デイヴィッド氏と会食。
lines.en: This evening we have dinner with William and David.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. Slight pause before the names — they carry weight. Composed delivery. Not reading a list; informing with precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ゲイツ氏の財団からも、視察団が来ますか。
lines.en: Will the Gates Foundation be sending observers as well?
lines.style: Careful question. Slight hesitation before 'Gates Foundation' — checking the appropriateness of the assumption. Respectful but not deferential. Seeking clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。受付フラワーアレンジ、蘭が映える季節だ。
lines.en: Yes. The reception flowers are arranged well — it's peak season for orchids.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Slight warmth in noticing the detail. Slow, meandering tone — a moment of reflection breaking through the business. Soft at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 是非とも、議事録取らせていただきます。
lines.en: I'd be happy to take the minutes for the meeting.
lines.style: Eager but measured. No over-offering. Straightforward, efficient tone. Brief pause after 'happy' — sincerity without fuss. Respectful closure.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。最終アタックのプレゼン、君も準備しろ。
lines.en: Good. Prepare for the final presentation pitch too.
lines.style: Shift to directness. Warmer than the opening — more collaborative than commanding. Light weight on 'too.' Not an afterthought, but an inclusion. Expects competence.
